name: Freyja
source:
The Goddess of the Moon, who controls the flowers. She was originally a human.

With a beautiful yet cruel personality, she creates the "Children of the Goddess" to dispel her loneliness.

She's both the most pathetic and dear goddess.

"Are you accepting me who denied you?"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
